name: Tele Group Corp.
summary: Tele Group Corp., an emerging Web 2.0 software developer established in 2007 and headquartered in New York City, concentrates on creating internet-based applications and digital platforms, primarily for the U.S. market. The company provides diverse advertising solutions, encompassing search, display, and interactive formats, designed to engage targeted consumers effectively. Currently, its pipeline of developing products includes NeXplore Search, a search engine boasting a visual interface for direct user interaction with both results and advertisements, and enabling result refinement through the collective insights of social communities. Another key offering is NeXplore Ads, a proprietary platform empowering marketers to craft, oversee, and dynamically adjust targeted interactive online advertising initiatives in real-time. The company is also developing HitLabel.com, an online destination hosting music contests and offering musicians viral promotion tools to connect with their audience; MyCircle.com, a versatile, application-independent social computing platform providing users a unified, customizable dashboard for managing their varied online interactions; and AdCircle, an interactive, visually-rich online classifieds platform connecting buyers and sellers. Formerly NeXplore Corporation, the company adopted the name Tele Group Corp. in December 2020.
